summary: Revenue is down about 7% this month, costing roughly ₹26 lakh, and it's tied to enterprise accounts shrinking and fulfilment slipping below 89%. Complaints jumped 29%, which likely follows straight from those missed deliveries. Marketing conversion looks broken rather than just bad, down sharply on its own — worth checking tracking before assuming demand is weak.
watchlist: Enterprise account losses and fulfilment SLA — decide on service recovery today
Marketing conversion drop — verify tracking isn't the culprit before cutting spend
Complaint rate spike — likely downstream of SLA misses, watch next week's trend
